Subject: Quick recap + VP/CTO availability, MAP & next steps

Thanks again for taking the time this morning, James — great discussion on Orion's time-series inference use case and the throughput/latency targets you mentioned. Short recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum.

Recap (call highlights)
- Primary goal: reduce inference tail latency for 1k qps bursts across multi-region reads.
- Success metrics: 95th p50 token latency < 120ms for typical prompt lengths, cost target < $0.03/token equivalent for batch inference.
- Data constraints: logs retained 90 days, PII redaction required for certain fields.

Proposed next steps
1) VP/CTO alignment (30 min) — unblock procurement + executive sponsorship.
   - Proposed windows: Tue 20 May 2025 11:00–11:30 PT OR Wed 21 May 2025 09:00–09:30 PT
   - Calendar booking link: https://calendar.redwood.com/book?slot=VPCTO-21-May-09am
2) Technical deep dive (60 min) with infra + engineering — cover model footprint, quantization options, and runbook.
3) Mutual Action Plan (attached) + pilot scope workbook. Please review before the exec call; we'll use the MAP to align deliverables and timeline.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (2pg MAP), pilot-scope.xlsx (pilot milestones & success criteria)

Ask: Can you confirm which VP/CTO window you prefer and whether Priya (CTO) should be invited to the 30-min alignment? If neither slot works, send 2 alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — I’ll loop Ben in on pricing/contract guardrails once the exec call is locked.

Best,
